GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, allowed drift back & Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, railed up to 4 Lengths turning, Held Up home turn , off heels Straightening Up and ran on hitting Lead 60m from post # ran on well/solid

Jumped okay, slow into stride then Eased & Settled Down last 10 Lengths from the lead, hooked 3 Wide at 750m and made no ground to Turn then Hooked Out to 8 Lengths Five Wide , Lost Ground in Straight # Wide last 750m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced wide from the 700m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Drifted Back Settled Down 9th Outside 9 Lengths same to turn Ridden Along clear run home Never Likely but was # good final 50m
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 6.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Hooked Out Four Wide Straightening Up and Made Ground in Straight # back/ran on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When under pressure in the straight, laid in. Rdr dropped whip near the 50m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Checked 1100m & Settled Down 8 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 10 Lengths turning, improved Two Wide rounding turn, steered around heels Straightening Up then ran on solidly hitting Lead 40m from post. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages. Performed above market expectations. Trainer reported he had been very pleased with its lead-up work and that its fresh record was very good despite 1200m being short of its best distance.] # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start & then contacted. Raced keen early. Checked passing the 1100m when racing in restricted room and then awkwardly placed close to heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok landing handily settled down 5 Lengths off the lead Two Wide (1500m), urged along 600 going backwards Soon After , faded Further Straight # spent before turn
Jumped okay, angled across & Settled Down Mid Field 6 Lengths 3 Wide , worked further forward and in Two Wide at the 1400m, Drifted Back to turn, improved only marginally in Straight # Wide early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start. Raced wide early.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out, not bustled early & Settled Down 12 Lengths 3 Wide , Two Wide last by the 1500m, Made Ground to 7 Lengths 3 Wide turning, only Held Ground in straight. [Stewards: Jockey reported it didn't handle the tight turning track. Post-race vet exam revealed it to be lame in the right hindleg. Vet clearance required.] # Pulled up lame.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Rdr reported gelding didn’t handle the tight turning track. A post race vet exam revealed lameness in the right hind leg. Vet clearance prior to racing or trialling again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat touch Worse than midfield Two Wide 6 Lengths 1000m, worked into the race Wide before the corner, he had a good look around joining in at 200m, knuckled down last 100m and went away for impressive win # finished too well

Jumped ok off the Wide draw, improved to better than Mid Field 6 Lengths still Wide though, margin 4 Lengths 1000 still posted & no cover, 5 deep cornering, Under Whip held Ground no run on, fair enough too # Wide no cover all

Slow out then Eased & Settled Down 9.5 Lengths Two Wide , puched 3 Wide rounding home turn the first time, back in Two Wide entering back turn, Made Some Ground to 8 Lengths 3 Wide turning, fairly one-paced in Straight # back/one-paced

Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths on fence, made no ground to Turn then shifted wider Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in straight. (Tongue Tie FIRST TIME) [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # battled on fairly
